newsitem.title: USA: Delta Air wing flap falls off, crashes near road.
newsitem.headline: Delta Air wing flap falls off, crashes near road.

text.p: A wing flap from a Delta Air Lines jet fell off and crashed to the ground by a major road near Dallas on Thursday but no one was injured, officials said.
Police said the wing flap section, about 18 feet (5.5 metres) long, fell off as the Boeing 767 jet approached Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport at the end of its flight from Orlando, Fla.
It plummeted into a field just a few feet from a major intersection in the Dallas suburb of Carrollton and about 100 yards (metres) from a residential neighbourhood and a nursing home.
Nobody was hurt and the plane, which was carrying 189 passengers, landed safely minutes later.
Delta spokeswoman Kim King said the pilot reported flight control problems and several emergency vehicles were deployed to the runway but the plane made a clean landing.
She said the National Transportation Safety Board would investigate the incident.
